With **0 layers transferred**, RACE dev accuracy is **about 40%**. With **all 12 layers transferred**, it is **about 60%** (page 7, Figure 2 left).

The paper gives no exact numbers for these points. I read them from the solid blue "RACE Dev" line, which is plotted against the left-hand "RACE Dev Accuracy" axis, so they are approximate. The caption says the plot shows the "Effect of transferring increasing number of layers from the pre-trained language model on RACE and MultiNLI" (page 7).

The only figure stated in the text for this experiment is for MultiNLI, not RACE: "each transformer layer provides further benefits up to 9% for full transfer on MultiNLI" (page 7).

The RACE score of 59.0 in Table 3 (page 6) is a separate number from the main results table. It is not labelled as dev accuracy, so I did not use it here.
